suppress.notes: False positive: jackrabbit-spi-*.jar, jackrabbit-spi-commons-*.jar, jackrabbit-jcr-commons-*.jar The generic cpe:apache:jackrabbit matches every Jackrabbit artifact. CVE-2026-92414 affects jackrabbit-jcr-server and CVE-2026-92415 affects jackrabbit-spi2dav, and this project depends on neither. jackrabbit-spi-commons is used only to generate the TypeScript declarations, and it brings jackrabbit-spi and jackrabbit-jcr-commons. No bundle embeds any of them. The pattern names each artifact, so jackrabbit-jcr-server, jackrabbit-spi2dav or jackrabbit-webdav stays reported.
